name: print-social-black-and-white-cover-with-pink-script-and-block
title: Greyscale portrait cover with pink script, giant caps and a tilted pink label
whatItIs: A black-and-white photo of a woman sipping from a cup with lipstick print, overlaid with a hot-pink script number, a giant white extended caps word, a tilted pink rounded rectangle with black caption text, white scribbles and a handle pill.
whatItMeans: Edgy, feminine and confident; pink punches through the monochrome photo.
techniques: Convert the photo to greyscale so a single pink can dominate.
Pair a flourished pink script with a very heavy extended sans word.
Tilt a pink caption block to break the grid.
Add white chalk doodles as accents.

vocabulary.definition: A black-and-white photo that lets colour accents stand out.
A flowing script word for emphasis.
A rotated colour rectangle holding text.
